import heapq
def solve3(start_reds,start_bar,maxmoves=40):
    st0=(frozenset(start_reds),start_bar)
    pq=[(1000*1+0,1,0,st0,[('at',start_bar)])]  # cost=pours*1000+moves
    best={st0:(1,0)}
    while pq:
        c,p,m,st,path=heapq.heappop(pq)
        bp,bm=best.get(st,(99,99))
        if (p,m)>(bp,bm): continue
        reds,bar=st
        w=bar[2]-bar[1]+1
        for rb in range(4,14):
            for cb in range(0,16-w+1):
                pbar=(rb,cb,cb+w-1)
                if not disj(pbar,reds): continue
                mv=m+man(bar,pbar)
                if mv>maxmoves: continue
                nw,wet,stt,tgt=pour3(reds,pbar)
                if stt=='FATAL': continue
                if nw==3: return (p+1,mv+1,path+[('move',pbar),('WIN POUR',tuple(wet))])
                if stt=='swap':
                    nr=set(reds); nr.discard(tgt); nr.add(pbar)
                    ns=(frozenset(nr),tgt)
                    np_,nm=p+1,mv+1
                    if (np_,nm)<best.get(ns,(99,99)):
                        best[ns]=(np_,nm)
                        heapq.heappush(pq,(1000*np_+nm,np_,nm,ns,path+[('move',pbar),('swap',tgt,'->reds',sorted(nr))]))
    return None

from collections import deque
def bfs_target(start,P,target_fn):
    def ov(p,q): return abs(p[0]-q[0])<4 and abs(p[1]-q[1])<4
    def mv(s,st):
        dr,dc={'UP':(-4,0),'DOWN':(4,0),'LEFT':(0,-4),'RIGHT':(0,4)}[s]
        a,b=st
        nl=(a[0]+dr,a[1]+dc); nr=(b[0]+dr,b[1]-dc)
        if nl in P and not ov(nl,b): a=nl
        if nr in P and not ov(nr,a): b=nr
        return (a,b)
    dd={start:0}; par={}; q=deque([start])
    while q:
        cur=q.popleft()
        if target_fn(cur):
            path=[]; c=cur
            while c in par: p,s2=par[c]; path.append(s2); c=p
            return list(reversed(path))
        for s in ('UP','DOWN','LEFT','RIGHT'):
            ns=mv(s,cur)
            if ns==cur or ns in dd: continue
            dd[ns]=dd[cur]+1; par[ns]=(cur,s); q.append(ns)
    return None

            s=(nL,nR)
            if s in seen: continue
            seen[s]=seen[(L,R)]+name
            if adj(nL,nR): return seen[s]

def bfs_hadj(PASS,HAZ,marker,sL,sR):
    from collections import deque
    FREE=PASS-{marker}
    M={'U':((-1,0),(-1,0)),'D':((1,0),(1,0)),'L':((0,-1),(0,1)),'R':((0,1),(0,-1))}
    start=(sL,sR)
    q=deque([(start,[])]); seen={start}
    while q:
        st,path=q.popleft()
        for name,(dl,dr) in M.items():
            (l1,l2),(r1,r2)=st
            dL=(l1+dl[0],l2+dl[1]); dR=(r1+dr[0],r2+dr[1])
            if dL in HAZ or dR in HAZ: continue
            if dL==(r1,r2) and dR==(l1,l2): nL,nR=dL,dR
            else:

                nR=dR if (dR in FREE and dR!=L) else (r1,r2)

            if ns==st: continue

            if a==c and abs(b-d)==1: return path+[name]
            if ns not in seen:
